description_en: Verifies that you own the specified domain name. Domain ownership must be verified before you can add a domain name to Web Application Firewall (WAF) by using CNAME access
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi verify-domain-owner --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-00000 --domain-name example.com --verify-type dnsCheck --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: VerifyDomainOwner

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to obtain the WAF instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name whose ownership you want to verify
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的域名名称。

您可以设置该参数，模糊查询某个域名是否已接入WAF防护
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The verification method. Valid values:

dnsCheck: DNS verification.

fileCheck: File verification
parameters.help_zh:
校验方式，取值：

dnsCheck：DNS验证。
fileCheck：文件验证
parameters.name: verify_type

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type used for file verification. This parameter is required only when you set VerifyType to fileCheck. Valid values:

HTTP: the HTTP protocol.

HTTPS: the HTTPS protocol
parameters.help_zh:
文件验证时，使用的协议类型，近在VerifyType选择fileCheck时输入。取值：
HTTP：表示HTTP协议。
HTTPS：表示HTTPS协议
parameters.name: protocol

FailCode.description_en:
The reason why the verification failed.

DnsTxtVerifyFailed: The DNS TXT record does not match.

DnsServerError: The DNS server is abnormal.

VerifyFileNotExist: The verification file does not exist.

VerifyDomainNotAccess: Failed to access the domain name.

FileContentVerifyFailed: The file content does not match
FailCode.description_zh:
校验不通过原因
DnsTxtVerifyFailed: DNS的TXT记录不匹配
DnsServerError: DNS服务器异常
VerifyFileNotExist：校验的文件不存在
VerifyDomainNotAccess：访问域名失败
FileContentVerifyFailed：文件内容不匹配

Result.description_en:
The verification result. Valid values:

true: The verification is successful.

false: The verification failed
Result.description_zh:
校验结果。取值：
true：表示校验通过。
false：表示校验不通过
